input.unit: sum of national loss / national GDP ratios; equal GDP-normalized country notional, not USD pool capital

protocol.split: chronological fixed 75 percent training, 25 percent heldout
protocol.fit_data: training years only, including marginal GPD fitting and cumulant targets
protocol.sampling: fixed scrambled Sobol uniforms, deterministic seed; wall time is measured and varies by host load
protocol.joint_exceedance: at least two countries exceed the same marginal PIT threshold
protocol.tail_loglikelihood: continuous joint loss density on all-positive heldout years with any PIT above 0.8
protocol.tvar_backtest: absolute ES identification moment divided by predicted ES
protocol.energy_score: 2048 forecast samples: mean observation distance minus half exact all-unordered-pairs forecast distance
not_identifiable: 99 percent and 99.5 percent tail calibration with only ten heldout annual observations
event-family GroupKFold from annual all-hazard aggregates
USD reinsurance capital without common-year exposure currency weights
protocol.quantum_scope: classical tensor network and state vector simulation, no quantum advantage claim
protocol.source_zero_caveat: OWID upstream ETL fills missing damage components with zero before annual aggregation; no additional missing country year imputation is performed here
